purpose: Evidence-driven tuning hints for isolated specialist editing. Human review is required before changes are promoted to main.

search-replace-no-exact-match.promptHint: Use the target map's exact source context and make the smallest patch against the named symbol. If an anchor differs, re-read the current target context and adapt rather than guessing.

no-product-change.promptHint: Materialize one minimal owned-file change that directly satisfies one acceptance criterion; do not return prose.

infrastructure.promptHint: Do not change code strategy for infrastructure failures; preserve the candidate and classify the infrastructure issue.
